title: Identification of small-molecule ligand-binding sites on and in the ARNT PAS-B domain.
authors: Xu, Xingjian; Closson, Joseph D; Marcelino, Leandro Pimentel; Favaro, Denize C; Silvestrini, Marion L; Solazzo, Riccardo; Chong, Lillian T; Gardner, Kevin H
one_liner_zh: 该文结合NMR、分子动力学模拟和集合对接，鉴定ARNT PAS-B结构域上的小分子配体结合位点，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作相关转录因子结构域研究，但核心是小分子-蛋白结合而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: Transcription factors are challenging to target with small-molecule inhibitors due to their structural plasticity and lack of catalytic sites. Notable exceptions include naturally ligand-regulated transcription factors, including our prior work with the hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF)-2 transcription factor, showing that small-molecule binding within an internal pocket of the HIF-2alpha Per-Aryl hydrocarbon Receptor Nuclear Translocator (ARNT)-Sim (PAS)-B domain can disrupt its interactions with its dimerization partner, ARNT. Here, we explore the feasibility of targeting small molecules to the analogous ARNT PAS-B domain itself, potentially opening a promising route to modulate several ARNT-mediated signaling pathways. Using solution NMR fragment screening, we previously identified several compounds that bind ARNT PAS-B and, in certain cases, antagonize ARNT association with the transforming acidic coiled-coil containing protein 3 transcriptional coactivator. However, these ligands have only modest binding affinities, complicating characterization of their binding sites. We address this challenge by combining NMR, molecular dynamics simulations, and ensemble docking to identify ligand-binding "hotspots" on and within the ARNT PAS-B domain. Our data indicate that the two ARNT/transforming acidic coiled-coil containing protein 3 inhibitors, KG-548 and KG-655, bind to a beta-sheet surface implicated in both HIF-2 dimerization and coactivator recruitment. Furthermore, while KG-548 binds exclusively to the beta-sheet surface, KG-655 can additionally bind within a water-accessible internal cavity in ARNT PAS-B. Finally, KG-279, while not a coactivator inhibitor, exemplifies ligands that preferentially bind only to the internal cavity. All three ligands promoted ARNT PAS-B homodimerization, albeit to varying degrees. Taken together, our findings provide a comprehensive overview of ARNT PAS-B ligand-binding sites and may guide the development of more potent coactivator inhibitors for cellular and functional studies.
abstract_zh: 转录因子因其结构可塑性和缺乏催化位点，难以用小分子抑制剂靶向。值得注意的例外包括天然配体调控的转录因子，其中包括我们先前对缺氧诱导因子 (hypoxia-inducible factor, HIF)-2 转录因子的研究，表明在 HIF-2α Per-Aryl hydrocarbon Receptor Nuclear Translocator (ARNT)-Sim (PAS)-B 结构域的内部口袋内进行小分子结合，可破坏其与二聚化伙伴 ARNT 的相互作用。在此，我们探索将小分子靶向类似 ARNT PAS-B 结构域本身的可行性，这可能为调节多种 ARNT 介导的信号通路开辟一条有前景的途径。通过溶液 NMR 片段筛选，我们先前鉴定了若干结合 ARNT PAS-B 的化合物，并在某些情况下拮抗 ARNT 与转化酸性卷曲螺旋蛋白 3 转录共激活因子的结合。然而，这些配体仅具有适度的结合亲和力，使其结合位点的表征复杂化。我们通过结合 NMR、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和整体对接来解决这一挑战，以识别 ARNT PAS-B 结构域上及其内部的配体结合“热点”。我们的数据表明，两种 ARNT/转化酸性卷曲螺旋蛋白 3 抑制剂 KG-548 和 KG-655 结合于一个 β-折叠表面，该表面涉及 HIF-2 二聚化和共激活因子招募。此外，虽然 KG-548 仅结合于 β-折叠表面，KG-655 还可结合于 ARNT PAS-B 内一个水可及的内腔。最后，KG-279 虽不是共激活因子抑制剂，但代表了仅优先结合内腔的配体。所有三种配体均促进 ARNT PAS-B 同源二聚化，尽管程度不同。综合来看，我们的发现提供了 ARNT PAS-B 配体结合位点的全面概述，并可能指导开发用于细胞和功能研究的更有效共激活因子抑制剂。
